meta.name: academic-plotting
meta.description: Generates publication-quality figures for ML papers from research context. Given a paper section or description, extracts system components and relationships to generate architecture diagrams via Gemini. Given experiment results or data, auto-selects chart type and generates data-driven figures via matplotlib/seaborn. Use when creating any figure for a conference paper.

copy.tagline: 为机器学习论文生成出版级图表
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在撰写机器学习论文并需要高质量图表
copy.tagline_en: Generate publication-quality figures for ML papers
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are writing a machine learning paper and need high-quality figures

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 根据论文上下文自动生成两种图表：一是用Gemini绘制架构图、流程图等示意图；二是用matplotlib/seaborn绘制柱状图、折线图等数据图。
howto.when: 当你需要为机器学习论文创建图表时触发，包括架构图、系统流程图或基于实验数据的数据图。

say.text: 帮我画一个我们方法的架构图，包含编码器、解码器和注意力模块。

howto.what_en: Automatically generates two types of figures from paper context: architecture/system diagrams using Gemini, and data-driven charts (bar, line, scatter, etc.) using matplotlib/seaborn.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to create figures for a machine learning paper, including architecture diagrams, system flowcharts, or data charts from experimental results.

say_en.text: Draw an architecture diagram of our method with encoder, decoder, and attention modules.
Create a grouped bar chart from these results: GPT-4: 86.4, Ours: 88.1, Llama-3: 79.3.
say_en.note: Triggers Workflow 2 for data chart generation.
